full_proxy_behavior: Explicit full-operator acknowledgement and pinned contract file digest required.
Native initialize, session headers and complete tool catalog checked before admitting actions.

4 MiB request/16 MiB response budgets admit the native 1 MiB binary payload in base64 JSON.
Lost write responses are reported unknown and never automatically retried; arguments/credentials are absent from generic errors.
Runtime token stays local and upstream is fixed to IPv4 loopback HTTP /mcp; no new public listener.
